label: The invitation
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1536x1024 landscape desktop WEBSITE first-viewport composition variation using the supplied Birdcar comp as the visual identity reference. Keep its black cherry #291e2e, pale orchid #f5f0f8, lilac #c9b4ed and dusty rose #dda8c7. Keep Alkaline brush-script logo/display, Karla body and restrained Commit Mono small facts. The real licensed Alkaline will be used in code; approximate the reference character faithfully. Keep quiet navigation: Birdcar, How I work, Selected work, Writing, Book a free assessment. Keep the single luminous horizontal optical horizon opening into a pale reading section at the fold. This is clean classic typography and precise Silicon Valley glitz made personal. No illustrations, photographs, objects, data dashboards, metrics, badges, decorative eyebrow text, cards, fake proof, grid wallpaper or gradient lettering. An actual usable website with clear CTA, not a poster. Text stays solid and readable. Preserve exact headline "Make room for better work." and intro "I help businesses untangle work that’s become harder to keep up with." Include "Book a free assessment" and actual about-an-hour free meeting and retained report terms. First glimpse of next pale section names "Craft & Communicate" with true existing report-platform proof. Change COMPOSITION ONLY, not identity, offer or palette.
COMPOSITION: A LARGE LEFT-ALIGNED TWO-LINE Alkaline headline spans the upper stage at x110-1350, y145-400: "Make room" then "for better work." Supporting information forms a carefully paced lower TWO-COLUMN BASELINE inside the dark hero, with the first-person introduction at x110-790, y470, followed by "The reporting someone spends Friday assembling. The follow-up that depends on your memory. The process that keeps landing back on your desk." in readable regular Karla. At x1000-1420, y470, show the invitation as a small Karla heading "Let’s start with what’s painful." and a readable 2-3 line explanation "I’ll spend about an hour with you, then write up what I’ve understood and the improvements I recommend." Then a pale lilac booking button around y620 and beneath "The assessment is free. The report is yours to keep." NO boxed card or separating vertical rule: negative space organizes these two supporting passages. The luminous horizon lies at y770, the pale next section begins y825 showing modest "Work in practice." at left and Craft & Communicate proof at right. This is more editorial and offer-forward than the reference's centered opening, with ample calm in the right half of the top headline area. Same elegant midnight plum, pale lavender, single subtle optical effect. Keep a coherent live-website rhythm, crisp nav and readable buttons.
